function: Channel estimation of multi-antenna monostatic backscatter links, with ambient-interference estimation and cancellation, for M backscatter devices (pp. 3, 5-6).
system: Full-duplex reader with N = 2 to 8 antennas and M single-antenna backscatter devices; no RIS; UHF band, f = 915 MHz (pp. 4, 9).
method: Deep unfolding network MUCE: projected gradient descent of LS unrolled into L layers with learnable parameters; supervised training with Adam against true channels (pp. 8-9).
data_channel: Custom simulator: flat quasi-static Rayleigh block fading with free-space path loss; 6000 training and 2000 validation samples randomly generated; no public data (p. 9).
test_conditions: Validation samples drawn from the same simulated model as training; each (M, N) setting evaluated separately, network size depends on M and N; SNR swept 0 to 30 dB (pp. 8-10).
baselines: Classical: LS and OMP. Learned: BCECNN (authors' CNN benchmark), EPFormer [50], PruningCNN [51] (pp. 10, 13, 14).
metrics: NMSE (mean, max, min, CDF), validation time and training time (pp. 10-13).
complexity: Order O(M^3 N^6) for MUCE and O(M^3 N^6) + O(M^4 N^8) for LS; measured validation and training times (pp. 8, 10, 13, 14).
q1_support: p. 9: "We model all links as being subject to flat quasi-static Rayleigh block fading." Custom simulator; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 9: "a training set containing 6000 samples and a validation set of 2000 samples, which are randomly generated from the established system model". Only an SNR sweep (p. 10); no unseen scenario, band or dataset is tested.
q3_support: p. 13: "our MUCE method achieves comparable channel estimation performance to EPFormer [50], while outperforming BCECNN, PruningCNN [51], and LS" (mean NMSE, Fig. 13); OMP also on p. 10.
q4_support: p. 8: "The computational complexity is O(M 3 N 6 )"; LS order on p. 14 and measured validation and training times in Tables 1-4 (pp. 10-12).
q5_support: p. 9: "randomly generated from the established system model". Simulated data only; the paper gives no link or DOI to code or data and no data availability statement.
notes: Title on page 1 matches the DOI. Backscatter system with a multi-antenna reader, so not single-antenna; area 2 (channel estimation). RIS appears only in related work (pp. 2, 4). The multipath model of [45] is cited on p. 5 but the simulation on p. 9 uses flat Rayleigh fading. BCECNN is the authors' own CNN benchmark (p. 14). Generalization is claimed on p. 13 but not tested.
